name: Mpingo
description: Star of 6,050 K, 363 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-71 b crosses Mpingo as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: WASP-71
quotes.card: WASP-71, also named Mpingo, is an ordinary star with a close-orbiting planetary companion in the equatorial constellation of Cetus.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent visual magnitude of 10.56, it is too faint to be visible to the naked eye.
